In the grand detective story of coffee brewing, we often obsess over the obvious suspects: grind size, water temperature, and contact time. But the true mastermind lurking in the shadows—the variable that actually solves the entire case—is Extraction Mass. Much like a classic Sherlock Holmes investigation, you can inspect the aromatic clues in the room and taste the flavor notes on your palate, but until you account for the exact mass of your liquid extraction, you’re missing half the crime scene. In specialty coffee, we love a good secret. We romanticize proprietary recipes and elusive techniques, treating extraction mass like some backstage whisper. Who else will be participating in the cupping tomorrow? #SpecialtyCoffee #CoffeeCupping #DecafCoffee #AfricanSchoolOfCoffee #ZukaGreenCoffee #TriBeCaCoffee #CoffeeCommunity #SensoryExperience
